ai_summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited has received final regulatory approval from NSE and BSE to list and trade 41.92 million new equity shares issued to former shareholders of J. B. Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Limited, following their amalgamation scheme. These shares will be admitted for dealings from July 28, 2026, formalizing the integration of JB Chemicals' shareholders and increasing Torrent Pharma's outstanding share count. This document details a standard procedural step post-merger, and no red flags are apparent.
